paragraphs: On Saturday morning, the Explorers met at the school gate at eight o'clock. Teacher Kim counted the children, and everybody was there. Then they took a bus to the town swimming pool. Lily, Mia, Leo, and May sat together at the back. Leo told a funny story about a fish, and the whole bus laughed. It was a sunny day, and the road to the pool was empty.

At the pool, the children did not swim. They watched a diving show from the seats. The water was clear and blue. First, a girl walked to the high board. She jumped, turned in the air, and went into the water with no sound. Mia took photos, and Lily wrote notes for the blog. After that, a boy jumped from the highest board, and everybody clapped. "I will never do that," said Leo. "My legs feel funny, and I am only watching!"

At eleven o'clock, the show ended, and the club walked to the bus stop. Suddenly Mia stopped. A heavy blue suitcase stood next to the bus stop sign, and nobody was near it. "Whose suitcase is it?" asked May. "It does not belong to us," said Teacher Kim. "It looks lost. Please do not touch it." So the children waited under a tree and looked around.

Finally, a guy in a yellow T-shirt ran across the street. He held a bottle of water in his hand. "That suitcase belongs to me!" he said. "I only went to buy some water." "Thank you for waiting with it." "We are the Explorers," said Leo, "and we look after things." The man laughed and said, "You are very good Explorers."

In the evening, Lily sat at the table with Mom, Dad, and Tom. She was very hungry, so she ate two plates of rice for supper. She told them about the diving show and the blue suitcase. Dad laughed when he heard about the suitcase. "Which story is better for the blog?" asked Tom. "The suitcase," said Lily, "because nobody knew the end." Pip sat under the table and waited for a piece of rice.
